# Emergency upgrade — ZKsync-OS ValidatorTimelock restore (stage)

One-off emergency upgrade executed via the `EmergencyUpgradeBoard`: a single PUH-owned
`ProxyAdmin.upgrade` call that restores the ZKsync-OS CTM ValidatorTimelock proxy back to a
`MultisigCommitter`. The v31 interopB stage-1 upgrade (block 10982340) downgraded it from a
MultisigCommitter (`0x8419fc5e…`) to a plain ValidatorTimelock (`0x31332716…`). Generated from
`deploy-scripts/upgrade/EmergencyValidatorTimelockRestore.s.sol` against Sepolia (chain 11155111).

> The L1 ChainAssetHandler migration relaxation was **dropped** from this proposal: the
> `SLHasDifferentCTM` same-CTM restriction is also enforced in the Migrator, so a CAH-only impl
> swap does not enable L1 → other-CTM-Gateway migration. The proposal is now VT-restore only,
> which changes the proposal id — so every `approveHash` value below differs from the earlier
> two-call draft (and from `0x544C…`/`0x4f56…` CAH drafts).
